renderer_scope: PBR scalars only; no texture, UV, subsurface, transmission, normal-map, or two-sided-material claim

intent.woody: Keep the young trunk matte and darker than the foliage without introducing bark texture claims.
intent.foliage: Increase leaf-versus-wood value/chroma and roughness separation so the sparse crown reads as a distinct surface family under more than one light direction.

truth_boundary: Derived look-development profile only. Exact source form and UC bridge geometry remain unchanged. This profile does not establish botanical color correctness, bark or leaf texture detail, subsurface/transmission, final art direction, renderer equivalence, runtime cost, CANON, production readiness, or materials mastery.
